verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers an 'Embed' feature to expose a mini API-interaction UI in a page and team/collection sharing for collaboration, which can serve as a lightweight internal portal, but there is no dedicated catalog/discovery portal product (no API marketplace, search, or documentation-portal feature) documented. missing for 10: a dedicated API catalog/portal product, discovery/search across published APIs, and evidence of teams actually using it as an internal developer portal.
